faq.question: How do I place an order?
faq.answer: You can place an order by adding items to your cart and proceeding to checkout.

faq.question: Can I place an order without creating an account?
faq.answer: Yes, you can place an order as a guest without creating an account.

faq.question: How can I track my order?
faq.answer: Once your order is shipped, you'll receive a tracking number via email to track your shipment.

faq.question: What payment methods do you accept?
faq.answer: We accept credit cards, debit cards, PayPal, and other digital payment methods.

faq.question: Can I change the shipping address after placing an order?
faq.answer: You can update your shipping address within 24 hours of placing the order by contacting customer service.

faq.question: How do I cancel my order?
faq.answer: You can cancel your order within 2 hours of placing it through your account dashboard.

faq.question: What is the estimated delivery time?
faq.answer: Delivery times vary depending on your location and the shipping method selected. Typically, it ranges from 3-7 business days.

faq.question: How do I return an item?
faq.answer: To return an item, visit the Returns section of your account and follow the instructions to request a return label.

faq.question: Will I receive a refund for shipping costs if I return my order?
faq.answer: Shipping costs are non-refundable, except in cases where the item is damaged or incorrect.

faq.question: Can I add items to an existing order?
faq.answer: Unfortunately, items cannot be added to an existing order. You'll need to place a new order for additional items.

faq.question: What happens if my order is delayed?
faq.answer: If your order is delayed, you'll receive an email notification with updated delivery details.

faq.question: Do you offer international shipping?
faq.answer: Yes, we offer international shipping to select countries. Shipping fees and delivery times will vary.

faq.question: How do I use a promo code on my order?
faq.answer: During checkout, enter your promo code in the 'Discount' field and click 'Apply'.

faq.question: What do I do if I receive the wrong item?
faq.answer: If you receive the wrong item, contact our customer service team to arrange for a return or exchange.

faq.question: Can I pay using multiple payment methods?
faq.answer: At this time, we only accept one payment method per order.

faq.question: How will I know when my order is confirmed?
faq.answer: Once your order is confirmed, you'll receive a confirmation email with your order details.

faq.question: What should I do if my payment is declined?
faq.answer: If your payment is declined, double-check your payment details or try a different payment method.

faq.question: Can I exchange an item instead of returning it?
faq.answer: Yes, exchanges are available for certain items. Visit the Returns section of your account for more details.

faq.question: How do I know if my order qualifies for free shipping?
faq.answer: Free shipping is available for orders over a certain amount, which will be indicated at checkout.

faq.question: How long does it take to process a refund?
faq.answer: Refunds typically take 5-10 business days to process, depending on your bank or payment provider.
